title: X-Men 2 - Wolverine's Revenge
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health; healing factor regenerates health
Wolverine has a few days to live after a virus: his healing factor regenerates health over time
Continues are limited; the game saves progress per slot

Claw combos
Claw combos, lunges and stealth takedowns; healing factor refills health while you avoid damage
Super-hero mode unlocks after the first clear (from the game's menu)

Sabretooth and others
Bosses include Sabretooth and other mutants and soldiers from the story
Back off and let the healing factor work between boss attack waves

rows: Canadian Wilderness, Mt. Arakawa (Japan), Underground Base, Xavier Institute, No Man's Island, Inner Island Fortress, Magneto's Lair, plus "Revenge Awakening" and "Sabretooth's Trail"

widgets.text:
Health
One-ups and power-ups found in levels
One-ups give extra lives; power-ups boost attacks

Hidden items
Scene gallery and secret gallery unlock with progress; Danger Room and time trial modes

Levels cleared
Levels cleared; level select and skip become available later
